newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PSE stagnate as financial sector swoons.
newsitem.headline: Czech PSE stagnate as financial sector swoons.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange slipped further on Thursday, as financial sector shares continued to swoon after a mini-bull run earlier in the week.
Komercni Banka, Ceska Sporitelna, Ceska Pojistovna all lost ground to help push the PX50 index down 2.1 points, or 0.39 percent, to close at 531.8.

The entire sector was buoyed earlier in the week after government officials announced bank IPB would be the first of the country's four major banks to be privatised, and a strong foreign strategic partner would be the most likely beneficiary of any sell off.
But the bubble that pushed the sector up lost its air by mid-week, and the market has since resumed its listless activity.
Overall activity on Thursday was modest, with 875,904 shares on turnover of 860.3 million crowns.
